item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Sharif personally rolled back the X ban, reduced PTA/PEMRA controls, or issued a clear pro-freedom directive against surveillance or shutdowns. The strongest “positive” material is indirect: court rulings that restrained censorship, not executive protection of political freedom. Several major restrictions began under the caretaker setup before Sharif took office, but they persisted into his government and were not reversed.","evidence":[{"title":"Pakistan: Authorities must be transparent about internet disruptions and surveillance tech","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-08-26","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/08/pakistan-authorities-must-be-transparent-about-internet-disruptions-and-surveillance-tech/","summary":"Amnesty says Pakistani authorities were opaque about monitoring and surveillance technologies that block content, slow internet speeds, and use national firewalls.
